title: Ask it to interview you first
body: Before you ask an AI to build something, tell it: "Ask me questions one at a time until you understand what I want." You'll get a better first try and learn what you hadn't decided yet.

title: Make it show its plan
body: Ask for a numbered plan before any code. Read it, fix the one step that's wrong, then say go. Two minutes here saves twenty later.

title: Paste the error back
body: When something breaks, paste the full error message, not a summary. The answer is usually in the last three lines.

title: Start smaller than you think
body: Pick the version you could show in one minute. A tiny thing that works beats a big thing that almost does.
